prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Photo-only website editorial photograph, landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels or larger.
Primary request: A meticulous real-looking commercial electrical distribution cabinet in a spotless utility room, with orderly separate conductor runs and carefully arranged cable containment. Match the restrained graphite and signal-red photographic character of the supplied visual reference, but generate an entirely new electrical installation photograph.
Input images: The supplied website concept is a lighting, palette and craftsmanship reference only. Ignore all graphic elements.
Scene/backdrop: Clean neutral utility-room wall and the open front of a dark graphite electrical distribution cabinet.
Subject: Precisely arranged rows of DIN-rail circuit protection modules and separate neutral and earth terminal blocks. Insulated red, blue and green/yellow conductors are bundled into coherent separate routes, run at clean right angles within grey slotted cable ducts, and terminate cleanly into appropriate components without exposed copper. Cable entry glands and covered containment at the lower edge. The emphasis is careful orderly routing, not an instructional wiring diagram.
Style/medium: Refined architectural/editorial infrastructure photograph with authentic practical materials, crisp detail, subtly imperfect real metal and plastic textures. Natural industrial lighting with soft directional highlights. Electrical hardware is realistic and unbranded, with no invented certification badges.
Composition/framing: Landscape three-quarter close view, cabinet filling most of the frame, minimal clean utility wall visible at the side. Clear legible routing and arranged components, red as restrained accent against graphite and cool grey. Strong focus across the panel, no dramatic blur.
Constraints: An illustrative imagined installation, not an actual Motexo project. Full edge-to-edge PHOTO ONLY; no people, signs, branded products, logos, visible text, labels, certifications, icons, UI, diagrams, callouts, arrows, hotspots, overlay typography, watermark, frame or composited screenshot. No tangled cables, no exposed live metal, no sparks or unsafe scene.
